tools.name: get_gift_box_details
tools.description: What is in the logo mug gift box, how the logo prints, the card message rules, where it ships and how delivery works.

tools.name: quote_gift_boxes
tools.description: The total for a number of gift boxes with shipping included, the ship-by and expected delivery dates for an order paid today, and an occasion's last day to order.

tools.name: check_logo
tools.description: Fetches a logo from a file the user attached, a public image link or the company's website, checks that it can print on the mug, and stores it for a draft order. Give exactly one of logo_file, image_url or website. Returns a logo_ref for create_draft_order. Each call stores a new copy and places no

tools.name: create_draft_order
tools.description: Saves a draft of the order (the logo from check_logo, the card message, the sign-off, the occasion and the kind of gift) and returns a private link. The customer opens the link to check the preview and every card, add their recipient list and pay on the website. Takes no recipient names or addresses

tools.name: get_order_status
tools.description: Says whether a draft from create_draft_order has been paid, with the order number and ship-by date once it is, or whether its link has expired. Returns no names or addresses.
